location_description: West Warwick is a town in Kent County, Rhode Island, United States. The population was 31,012 at the 2020 census.West Warwick was incorporated in 1913, making it the youngest town in the state. Prior to 1913, the town, situated on the western bank of the Pawtuxet River, was the population and industrial center of the larger town of Warwick.
